mapper.select: SELECT sys26_login_id AS login_id, TO_CHAR(sys26_open_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS open_date_string, ( SELECT sys01_company_nm FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = emp01_company_id ) AS company_nm, emp01_kor_nm || '(' || emp01_emp_no || ')' AS person_nm, f_cdnm('LoginStatusCode', sys26_status_cd, 0, f_sysdate()) AS status_nm, f_cdnm('LoginModeCode', sys26_login_mode, 0, f_sysdate()) AS login_mode_nm, sys26_ip_address AS ip_address, sys26_os AS os, sys26_browser AS browser FROM sys26_login INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = sys26_person_id WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', sys26_open_date) BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('day', #{startDate}::timestamp) AND DATE_TRUNC('day', #{closeDate}::timestamp) AND CAST(emp01_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys26_login_mode, 'P') LIKE #{loginMode} AND sys26_status_cd != '20' UNION ALL SELECT sys26_login_id, TO_CHAR(sys26_open_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), ( SELECT sys01_company_nm FROM sys01_company WHERE sys01_company_id = sys02_company_id ), sys02_kor_nm || '(' || sys02_login_id || ')', f_cdnm('LoginStatusCode', sys26_status_cd, 0, f_sysdate()), f_cdnm('LoginModeCode', sys26_login_mode, 0, f_sysdate()), sys26_ip_address, sys26_os, sys26_browser FROM sys26_login INNER JOIN sys02_user ON sys02_user_id = sys26_person_id WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', sys26_open_date) BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('day', #{startDate}::timestamp) AND DATE_TRUNC('day', #{closeDate}::timestamp) AND CAST(sys02_company_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE #{companyId} AND COALESCE(sys26_login_mode, 'P') LIKE #{loginMode} AND sys26_status_cd = '20' ORDER BY open_date_string DESC
